Name: Realistic Looms
Author: ivycrowned
Description:
[size=4]As of February 2021, I am officially no longer maintaining this mod. Anyone who wants to maintain an updated version of this mod has my full permission. The loom sprite I've created may be used freely, and modified in any way. Enjoy.[/size]

This mod replaces the vanilla "loom" with an actual frame loom, and give the vanilla "loom" texture to a new machine that is accurately called a "spinning wheel".
Inputting wool into the spinning wheel will produce yarn, which can be processed in the loom to make cloth.

I am open to expanding wool type and yarn use in the future, so please send along any suggestions you have!
This mod [b]is[/b] compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1926]PPJA Artisan Valley[/url].

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1][*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]﻿.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list][*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.4 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer.
[*]Works with PPJA Artisan Valley. If you have Artisan Valley installed, the yarn in this JA content pack will be disabled, and the PPJA yarn will be used instead. All producer rules and recipes involving the loom and yarn in Artisan Valley will work with the edited loom in this mod.
[*]Not compatible with Trent's New Animals. This mod will work, but Trent's items will not work with this loom.
[/list][size=5]More Info[/size]
If you have any questions or requests, the fastest way to get to me is to ping or DM me (@asterochares#7302) on Discord.
